description: Get one funder's public profile from the FundingTracker directory by slug: financing type, description, website, its listed facts (type, max deal, payment schedules, ISO brokers, states), average merchant rating, review count and the most recent public reviews. When at least 3 merchants have an approved shared deal, also returns the deal count, average and range of factor rate, typical term, typical payment frequency, and an estimated APR from the calculator. Names, businesses, emails and exact amounts are not included.

slug.description: Funder slug from search_funders (e.g. 'apex-funding-group-llc') or its fundingtracker.app/funders URL.

name: get_funder
title: Get a funder profile
